review_notes: Segment 0: The sequence 'अर्जुनस्य अन्यत्र आत्मज्ञानाद् उद्धरणम् अपश्यन् भगवान् वासुदेवः ततः अर्जुनम् उद्धिधारयिषुः आत्मज्ञानाय अवतारयन्न् आह।' contains multiple forms that appear non-standard or conflated (e.g., 'उद्धरणम्', 'उद्धिधारयिषुः', 'आवतारयन्न्'). These were preserved as in the raw text; please review and correct Sanskrit sandhi/verb forms if needed.

Segment 10: "स्वकर्मणा तमभ्यर्च्य" — possible segmentation (तं अभ्यर्च्य?) should be verified.
Segment 10: "सिद्धिं प्राप्तस्य च पुनर्ज्ञाननिष्ठां वक्ष्यति" — consider whether intended reading is 'पुनः ज्ञाननिष्ठां' or 'पुनर्ज्ञाननिष्ठां'.

Segment 11: Several short Sanskrit fragments/phrases appear uncertain or possibly mistranscribed (e.g. "सिद्धिं प्राप्तो यथा ब्रह्म तथाप्नोति निबोध मे", "गीता सुबहो चनै", usages of 'संसिद्धि', "ईश्वर समर्पितेन", and "कर्मणा स संसिद्धिं"). These were left as in the original to avoid changing doctrinal meaning; please review against the source audio or authoritative text for precise Sanskrit wording.
Segment 11: The speaker repeats and uses colloquial insertions; repetition and style preserved per instructions.

Segment 12: Multiple Sanskrit phrases/shlokas remain verbatim from the raw transcript (e.g., 'तत्र तत्र दर्शयिष्यामः', 'तत्रैवं धर्मसंमूढचेताः सोऽर्जुनः', 'अन्यत्र आत्मज्ञानात् उद्धरणम् अपश्यन्', 'ततः अर्जुनम् उद्धिधारयिषुः', and the śloka beginning 'पूर्णमदः पूर्णमिदम्...'). These may contain ASR artifacts or variant sandhi/inflections; if exact canonical wording is needed, please have a Sanskrit expert verify.
